# creating Function to calculate summary statistics (my_summary_stats)

```{r}

my_summary_stats <- function(x) {

  my_results <- c(
    Mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Minimum = min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Maximum = max(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Standard_Deviation = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Variance = var(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  return(my_results)
}

# Apply the function to a variable

data <- c(10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60)

my_summary_stats(data)


```
#Function to calculate two-sample t-test 

```{r}

my_test <- function(x, y) {

  result <- t.test(x, y)

  return(result)
}

# Create two sample datasets

sample1 <- c(10, 12, 14, 16, 18)
sample2 <- c(20, 22, 24, 26, 28)

# Apply the function
my_test(sample1, sample2)

```
